Articles & Tutorials

Building an Advanced Agentic Harness (19 minute read)

An advanced agentic harness for production-sized agents is proposed here, emphasizing the need for well-structured operations through components like typed tools, directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), tiered memory, and verification hierarchies to create a reliable system capable of planning, acting, recovering, and self-evaluating. This architecture uses the composition of small, testable primitives to improve efficiency and performance while making sure the system remains extensible and adaptable.

The secure way to release an npm package in 2026 (25 minute read)

The increasing threat of supply chain attacks targeting npm packages requires heightened security measures for developers. Implementing strategies such as Trusted Publishing, npm Provenance, and Staged Publishing can reduce vulnerabilities while making sure that only approved releases are published.
🧠

Opinions & Advice

Should You Self-Host Inference? (14 minute read)

Self-hosting AI inference is good primarily when processing over two million tokens daily or when data cannot leave the organization's network. For most companies, a hybrid approach combining local and API models offers the best balance of cost and control.

The valley of webhooks (12 minute read)

Building systems that rely on webhooks for data synchronization consistently proves problematic due to their inherent nature as notifications rather than reliable data delivery methods. A proposed alternative is a designated change log that would eliminate issues like data drift and the need for complex mitigation strategies by allowing consumers to request updates directly from providers.
🚀

Launches & Tools

Prime Agent: A self-improving RLM agent (20 minute read)

Prime Agent is a self-improving coding harness that uses a Recursive Language Model and Continual Harness for better context management, multi-agent communication, and long-term evaluation, positioned as an effective tool for coding assistance and research while maintaining open-source accessibility.

Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work (13 minute read)

Cloudflare OS is an open-source platform designed to provide organizations with customized agent workspaces that helps with collaboration, task automation, and app development based on the company's internal knowledge and context. The platform incorporates a security framework to ensure safe access to internal data and resources, allowing users to create and share applications while managing access and costs effectively.

Introducing Hark Handoff (8 minute read)

Hark Handoff is a computer use agent designed to automate online tasks by navigating the internet as a human would, freeing users from mundane online activities. The agent excels in handling end-to-end tasks such as ordering food, shopping, making reservations, and conducting research.

Miscellaneous

The next chapter of our AI momentum (5 minute read)

Google and Alphabet are updating their AI initiatives, with Sundar Pichai highlighting the successful rollout of their Gemini models and the user engagement with AI applications. As part of a leadership transition, Demis Hassabis (CEO of DeepMind) will focus on shaping the future of artificial general intelligence (AGI), while Koray Kavukcuoglu will take on a more senior, primary role overseeing Google DeepMind's development and research efforts.

Why the Legendary Erdős Problems Are Falling to AI (21 minute read)

Recent advancements in AI have led to breakthroughs in solving classical mathematical problems proposed by Paul Erdős, regarding the use of unique mathematical techniques previously unexplored in the context of these challenges. As AI tools demonstrate increasing capabilities, they are reshaping the landscape of mathematical inquiry, attracting attention from both professional mathematicians and enthusiasts.

Born Against, or why hobby programming communities are aggressively against LLM usage (3 minute read)

Hobby programming communities are increasingly hostile toward LLMs because they view the process of mastering complex skills as essential to their craft, believing that LLM use undermines genuine learning and expertise.

Something Is Changing in the Unit Economics of Software (5 minute read)

The rise of AI has altered the unit economics of software by increasing costs associated with serving users, leading to a trade-off between product quality and profit margins.

Automating cross-repo documentation with GitHub Agentic Workflows (14 minute read)

The Aspire team successfully implemented GitHub Agentic Workflows to automate documentation processes, allowing them to generate and review documentation pull requests shortly after feature merges without additional resources.
